courts.title: Courts
courts.description: The courts CauseDeck knows, what it can read for each, and the way to each court's official pages.

planned.title: Planned
planned.hint: Catalogued but not available yet. They have no links until they are ready.

levels.label: Adapter level {level}
levels.A0: Known court. Share a list or order and we will read it with your confirmation.
levels.A1: Document-assisted. We read lists and orders you share and match them to your matters.

banner.hall: Couldn't read today's list for Hall {halls}
banner.halls: Couldn't read today's list for Halls {halls}
banner.newWindow: Opens the court's website in a new window

empty.title: Choose your courts to get started.
empty.hint: No forums are listed for this workspace yet. When they are, each shows what CauseDeck can read for it.

addForum.title: Add a forum
addForum.description: A court or forum your workspace uses that CauseDeck does not list yet. Only your workspace sees it.

website.label: Court website (optional)
website.hint: An https address. Links to it open in a new window.

code.label: Forum code
code.hint: A short dotted code, such as ws.chennai.city-civil-court.

errors.codeInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, with at least one dot.
errors.codeTaken: This code belongs to an existing forum. Choose another.
errors.websiteInvalid: Enter an https address, such as https://example.gov.in.
errors.forbidden: Only owners and advocates can add forums.
errors.failed: Couldn't add the forum. Try again.

halls.caption: Halls seen in your lists
halls.emptyHint: Halls appear here after you share a cause list for this forum. Each shows the date of its latest list and whether we could read it.

adapter.title: Adapter status
adapter.noAdapter: This forum has no adapter yet. You can still open the court's official pages from Links.
adapter.levelA0: A0, known court: we know the court and its official pages. Share a list or order and we read it with your confirmation.
adapter.levelA1: A1, document-assisted: we read the lists and orders you share and match them to your matters.
adapter.levelHigher: Higher levels, such as reading lists straight from the court, are not available yet.
adapter.notVerified: Not yet verified with real lists

accessModes.title: Access modes
accessModes.caption: How CauseDeck may get each resource for this court
accessModes.userSuppliedHelp: Share the list or forward the court email
accessModes.empty: No access modes are recorded for this court yet.

links.title: Official pages
links.newWindow: Opens the court's website in a new window
links.captcha: The court's page may ask you to solve a captcha. That is the court's requirement; Lawyer OS never solves it for you.
links.empty: No official pages are listed for this forum yet.
